description: Phase B: single source of truth and reproducible build. Depends on FEAT-001 (compare tool, audit numbers). Add scripts/build-css.js + npm scripts, widen postcss.config.js content to globs (html, js, *-page*.css, routes, lib, server.js) and add a PurgeCSS safelist of PATTERNS derived from a dynamic-class scanner, write public/CSS-README.md, then prove with snapshots whether the regenerated styles.deduped.min.css can replace the committed one (expected: NOT, then take the frozen-artifact fallback), and decide with snapshot evidence whether leaderboard.html may switch from raw styles.css to the deduped file. Never change link order.
steps: Capture $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\snap-lb-before with a new tmp-css-snapshot-lb.js (leaderboard only, 4 viewports + states discovered from leaderboard.html/leaderboard-page.js, supports --css-swap deduped via context.route on the HTML response). Capture it from the untouched tree BEFORE any edit.

Write tmp-css-dyn.js (plan B.3 items 1-6) scanning public/**/*.js|html, routes, lib, server.js plus CSS attribute-selector substrings plus the cached Bootstrap/FontAwesome/Remixicon text; review the output by hand; keep $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\dyn-prefixes.json for FEAT-003.

Edit postcss.config.js: content GLOBS (./public/**/*.html, ./public/**/*.js, ./public/**/*-page*.css, ./routes/**/*.js, ./lib/**/*.js, ./server.js) and a safelist (check the option shape in node_modules/purgecss: safelist {standard,deep,greedy}) of regex PATTERNS with a comment naming the file:line evidence for each; no file lists. Keep plugin order and defaultExtractor.

Create scripts/build-css.js (plan B.2: chdir to repo root, CRLF->LF, postcss API with the config plugins, LF output, flags --out/--check/--report/--force, prints bytes+SHA-256, deterministic) and add package.json scripts build:css and build:css:check. Run it twice to a temp --out and assert identical SHA-256.

Regeneration proof (plan B.5): build to a temp file, compute the drift vs committed, temporarily place the LF output at public/styles.deduped.min.css, run tmp-css-snapshot.js + tmp-css-compare.js against css-baseline. Zero diffs: keep it and commit the regenerated file in its own commit and make build:css write public/ by default and build:css:check use --check. Any diff: git checkout -- public/styles.deduped.min.css, switch to the frozen fallback (plan B.6: build:css writes to build/css/, check uses --report, build-css.js refuses to write public/ without --force), and save the drift summary for the report.

Leaderboard decision (plan B.7): capture snap-lb-deduped via --css-swap deduped, compare with snap-lb-before and run npm run test:e2e -- smoke a11y wrapping no-horizontal-overflow against a temp switch. Switch the single href ONLY if every element/prop/state is identical and e2e passes; otherwise keep raw styles.css and record the top differing elements in the README.

Write public/CSS-README.md (plan B.4, <=~150 lines) incl. the source/generated/frozen table, the exact generation command, LF/CRLF rule, why generated output stays committed, why leaderboard stays raw or switched, the Phase C criterion and the never-hand-edit rule; add one line to README.md linking it.

Run the 4.1 snapshot compare (zero diffs) after every commit that changes a served file, plus the e2e canary (smoke wrapping no-horizontal-overflow a11y). Commits (plan B.8): build(css): add reproducible CSS build script; docs(css): document CSS sources and generated files; [build(css): regenerate styles.deduped.min.css only if proven]; [leaderboard href commit only if proven].
acceptance_criteria: npm run build:css and npm run build:css:check exist; build output is deterministic (two runs, identical SHA-256) and written with LF

postcss.config.js content uses globs only and covers all public/*.html and public/*.js (so *-page.js and the split recipients files are covered) plus routes/lib/server.js; safelist contains dynamic-name PATTERNS each justified by a file:line comment

If styles.deduped.min.css changed in git, a zero-diff snapshot compare against css-baseline is recorded for it; if not, the file is byte-identical to e939a28 and the README states it is a frozen artifact, with the drift summary saved for the report

leaderboard.html link order is unchanged; the href is switched to styles.deduped.min.css only with identical per-element computed styles at both viewports plus states and a passing e2e canary, otherwise it stays on styles.css and the README explains why
public/CSS-README.md exists and is accurate; tests/ diff is empty; link order unchanged on every page (git -P diff on public/*.html is empty or only the single leaderboard href)
verification: node scripts/build-css.js --out "$env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\a.css"; node scripts/build-css.js --out "$env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\b.css"; compare SHA-256 (equal)
npm run test:e2e -- smoke wrapping no-horizontal-overflow a11y  (green)
findings:
FEAT-002 done on refactor/css-consolidate-1 (nothing pushed, no cr). Commits after e2cc2a4: ae89390 build(css): add reproducible CSS build script (scripts/build-css.js, package.json, postcss.config.js); 1aac802 docs(css): document CSS sources and generated files (public/CSS-README.md, README.md +1 line); bdc0199 perf(css): load deduped CSS on leaderboard page (public/leaderboard.html, one href). No regenerate commit (frozen fallback). tests/ diff e939a28..HEAD is empty; styles.deduped.min.css diff e939a28..HEAD is empty; the only .html change is the leaderboard href, link order untouched.

REGENERATED OR FROZEN: FROZEN (B.6 fallback). Rebuild with the new config (globs + safelist) = 37,758 B LF, sha256 02bd32112423ee6bf5ecadc6ad00f0ff569327741c43567c5113b3a30b4f1a44, deterministic (two runs and two npm runs identical). Committed blob 40,111 B LF sha256 eb22c6e6...2b18. Rule drift (build-css.js --report, keyframe steps included): committed 399 rules, rebuild 380; identical 326, changed declarations 14, only-in-committed 59, only-in-rebuild 40 (changed examples: nested :root --ios-success, .alert-success color, .btn-success(:hover), .recipient-item .btn-outline-success, .badge and .present-item max-width/overflow, .login-header/.login-body, @keyframes slideDown 0%, .list-group). Snapshot proof: rebuild copied over public/styles.deduped.min.css (then restored with git checkout) and compared with css-baseline: 56 files, 1,129 differing cells, exit 1. Pages with diffs: archiwum 26/viewport (104), formularz 21 (84), home 1 (4), osoby 1 (4), recipients 215/163/163/177 (718), ustawienia 32/31/31/32 (126), wiadomosci 23/23/23/20 (89); zero diffs on activity, index, intro, leaderboard, maintenance, register, rezerwacje. First diffs are the archiwum #archiveYearSelect.form-select (padding 6px 36px 6px 12px -> 14px 20px, border-radius 6px -> 16px, border 1px -> 2px, font-size 16px -> 15.2px): i.e. the rebuild is missing/has different .form-control/.form-select rules. Public file is therefore byte-identical to e939a28. build-css.js has FROZEN=true and refuses to write public/styles.deduped.min.css without --force.
  Drift evidence files: C:\Users\matmamon\AppData\Local\Temp\css-consolidate-1\drift-report-new.txt (build-css.js --report output), cmp-B-regen.txt (full compare output of the regen proof), snap-B-regen\ (snapshots of the rebuild), css-audit\drift.json (Phase A, old config). Copy drift-report-new.txt and the cmp-B-regen.txt head into the verification report appendix under "Decisions needed".

LEADERBOARD DECISION: SWITCHED to styles.deduped.min.css (commit bdc0199, one href, order unchanged). Evidence: new tmp-css-snapshot-lb.js (leaderboard only; 4 viewports x 11 states: base, scrolled-bottom, sidebar-open, tabbar-menu-open, notifications-panel-open, hover-podium, hover-ranking-card, hover-tab-item, empty-state, error-state, loading-state; ~650 elements (239 in empty/error/loading), 90 computed properties incl. text-align, cursor, min/max sizes, positions, plus bounding rect per element). Untouched-tree capture snap-lb-before is deterministic (two captures, 0 diffs after waiting 1.5 s for the tab-bar panel slide-in). --css-swap deduped (HTML rewritten via context.route) vs before: 0 diffs, 464,419 cells per viewport, exit 0. After the real edit, snap-lb-switched vs before: 0 diffs. Full 14-page harness after the switch (snap-B) vs css-baseline: 56 files, 0 diffs, exit 0. Canary npm run test:e2e -- smoke wrapping no-horizontal-overflow a11y with the switched href: 39 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed. Cross-check: rules that differ between the rebuild and the committed file do not target classes in leaderboard.html/leaderboard-page.js/tab-bar-functions.js/desktop-nav.js (only token hits were the word badge as a variable and highlightPresentItem selector .present-item, neither renders on that page; leaderboard uses btn btn-light btn-lg whose computed styles are identical at 320/375 widths). Caveat: only demo-server data was exercised (no ties, very long names or missing avatars beyond what demo data has).
  Files: C:\Users\matmamon\AppData\Local\Temp\css-consolidate-1\snap-lb-before, snap-lb-before2, snap-lb-deduped, snap-lb-switched, lb-deduped-compare.txt, cmp-lb-switched.txt, e2e-canary-lb.txt, snap-B (+ cmp-B.txt).

DYN-PREFIXES: C:\Users\matmamon\AppData\Local\Temp\css-consolidate-1\dyn-prefixes.json (written by W/.agents/tasks/tmp-css-dyn.js [outJson]; 72 sources, 19 CSS files). Keys: prefixes, suffixes, infixes, literalClassCalls (221, 15 dynamic), attributeSelectors, libraryToggles{all, definedInStylesCss}. Prefixes: accordion-bought-, accordion-own-, alert-, demo-image-, editComments-, editTitle-, lp-, notif-, recipient-, thread-; suffix -collapse; infixes (from CSS attribute selectors) col- and fa-users (aws-design.css:1058, 2506); library toggles (Bootstrap 5.3.0 bundle) active, show, showing, hiding, fade, collapse, collapsing, collapsed, collapse-horizontal, disabled, modal-open, modal-backdrop, modal-static, offcanvas-backdrop, dropdown-menu, slide, carousel-item-*, is-valid, is-invalid, was-validated. Only alert- is a real CLASS prefix (alert alert-${type}); the others are element ids or JS map keys but are safelisted anyway. Scanner limitations: regex based, ids built as "foo" + n without trailing dash are not detected (none seen); recipients-list.js appears in the parent workspace but not in this worktree (split-recipients is a sibling task): re-run tmp-css-dyn.js on the final tree in Phase C.

SNAP-LB-BEFORE: C:\Users\matmamon\AppData\Local\Temp\css-consolidate-1\snap-lb-before (captured at e2cc2a4, tree untouched, with leaderboard on raw styles.css). Since leaderboard now loads the deduped file, later phases that change styles.css cannot affect it; changes to bottom-tab-bar.css, app-theme.css, leaderboard-page.css still must be compared with this dir (use node .agents/tasks/tmp-css-snapshot-lb.js <dir>; then tmp-css-compare.js snap-lb-before <dir>). Harness quirk: tabbar-menu-open needs a 1.5 s wait.

FINAL NPM SCRIPTS: "build:css": "node scripts/build-css.js --out build/css/styles.deduped.min.css" (build/ is git-ignored); "build:css:check": "node scripts/build-css.js --report" (prints drift, exit 0; `node scripts/build-css.js --check` exits 1 on drift). Flags: --out, --check, --report, --force, --help. postcss.config.js: content globs ./public/**/*.html, ./public/**/*.js, ./public/**/*-page*.css, ./routes/**/*.js, ./lib/**/*.js, ./server.js; defaultExtractor and plugin order unchanged; safelist {standard: [bootstrap-toggled names regex], greedy: [/^alert-/, /^accordion-bought-/, /^accordion-own-/, /-collapse$/, /^editTitle-/, /^editComments-/, /^lp-/, /^recipient-/, /^notif-/, /^thread-/, /^demo-image-/, /col-/, /fa-users/]} each with a file:line comment. postcss.config.js and package.json keep CRLF; scripts/build-css.js is new (LF in the index).

NOTES FOR LATER PHASES: styles.css now has no page consumer, so Phase C changes to it are invisible to the snapshots (the compare would be vacuous): the required proof for styles.css is the rule-level tmp-css-rulecheck plus the fact that regeneration is not used; deduped stays frozen and untouched. Phase D (.container overflow) lives inside the frozen deduped file, so it needs the override variant (D.3), as the plan expected. CSS-README.md states 11 pages load the deduped file plus leaderboard (12); sw.js was not touched (single bump at the end, main was at v127 when checked in FEAT-001). Temp scripts added (untracked): tmp-css-snapshot-lb.js, tmp-css-dyn.js, tmp-css-b-*.js. Tool quirk: execute_pwsh swallows output of some native commands; redirect with cmd /c "... > file 2>&1" and read the file.
